title: Metanephrines in blood and urine
what: This blood or urine test checks substances made from stress hormones. It helps find rare tumors of the adrenal glands.
why: For attacks of high blood pressure with a racing heart, sweating, and headache, or when something was found in an adrenal gland.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes, urine is collected for 24 hours; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially for blood pressure, depression, and colds
If you drink a lot of coffee or energy drinks
If adrenal tumors run in your family
If you have sudden spells of very high blood pressure

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Some medicines distort the result. Do not stop anything on your own. Your doctor will say if anything needs to be switched.

prepare.title: Food and drinks
prepare.text: Usually for 24 hours: no coffee, strong tea, alcohol, or smoking. You are often asked to avoid bananas, nuts, and chocolate. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Blood
prepare.text: Blood is taken on an empty stomach. You usually lie down for about 20 to 30 minutes before the draw.

prepare.title: 24-hour urine
prepare.text: Do not collect the first morning urine. Then for 24 hours, pee into a large container. The last portion is the next morning. Sometimes a preservative is added. The lab will give it to you.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
The 24-hour urine container or a sample poured from it, as the lab says
The total urine volume for 24 hours, written down
steps: For the blood test, you lie down quietly for about half an hour
The nurse puts on a band and wipes the skin
A quick prick, and blood fills the tube
For the urine test, you bring all or part of the urine collected over 24 hours
The lab worker writes down the volume and the collection time
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Collecting urine for 24 hours does not hurt, but you must not miss a single portion
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
After the test, you can eat and drink as usual
The doctor will review the result. Sometimes the test is repeated
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red
An attack with very high blood pressure, a severe headache, or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.q: Can I drink coffee before the test?
faq.a: Usually not. Caffeine can distort the result. The lab will tell you exactly how long to avoid it.

faq.q: What if I missed one urine portion?
faq.a: You will need to start the collection again. Otherwise the result will not be accurate.

reminders.text: Metanephrines test tomorrow. Starting today: no coffee, alcohol, or smoking. Take medicines as your doctor said.
